reply_text:
㊥ [“Were the other outstanding items items OK?”] Yes. I rechecked both against the currently running Lucy checkpoint; both are resolved.

㊬ [“Missing verified Giraffe run”] Run `20261111T195837.113Z-cc4ffa45` passes the WM’s actual `verified-giraffe-run?` predicate. It contains exactly the isolated ladder-01 item, with complete manifest hashes and no reading drift.

㊬ [“Missing sandbox outer-loop makeup”] The serving JVM’s actual `load-makeup` call succeeds with schema `:wm/outer-makeup-v1`, resolving to `/home/joe/wm-sandbox/code/futon2/data/wm-learning/outer-makeup.edn`, SHA-256 `db05f30c…ba13`.

㊢ [runtime evidence] The third attempted click had already passed both checks and stopped only at the then-empty mission registry. That registry is now repaired too, and all three repairs are preserved in the refreshed `checkpoint-00`.

🈖 [reproducibility] The makeup repair also removed its former `/home/joe/code/futon2/...` assumption: it now resolves through the configured Futon data root, matching Rob’s portability concern.
